experiment: MIMIC-IV full v3.1 DKA real-data grey-box residual crossfit

model.training_target: residual derivative between DKABody mechanism rollout and observed 6h factual outcome

evaluation.unit_of_evidence: ICU stay; transition rows are averaged within stay
evaluation.split: GroupKFold by ICU stay; no stay appears in both train and heldout fold
evaluation.delta_definition: normalized MAE(method) - normalized MAE(persistence); negative is better

reference_baselines.validated_per_target_ensemble: mimiciv_full_v31_icd_per_target_ensemble.json is the factual advisory baseline. This grey-box audit uses only residual states, so scores are not target-identical to the ensemble report.

interpretation: This tests whether a small residual learned from real DKA transitions adds useful factual signal over persistence.
A pass would justify a candidate-only downstream JEPA experiment, not causal or clinical promotion.
A fail keeps the validated per-target ensemble as the current factual advisory artifact.
